#CLEANING DATA
```{r}
sum(is.na(Ctd_Verticals_LJ$sample.depth..m.))
sum(is.na(Ctd_Verticals_LJ$calanus.total.m3))

#Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Month=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Month.x
#Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Year=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Year.x
#Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Temp=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$T090C
#Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Salinity=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$D.Salinity
#Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Light=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Par

df_vertical <- Ctd_Verticals_LJ |>
  #Removing rows where depth or Calanus is NA
  filter(!is.na(sample.depth..m.),
         !is.na(calanus.total.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.I.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.II.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.III.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.IV.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.V.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.Adult.m3))|>
  arrange(ID, Date, sample.depth..m.) |>    #Sort depth from surface to bottom within each station 
  group_by(ID, Date, Year, Month) |>        #Work within each station visit
  mutate(
    cum_dens.total   = cumsum(calanus.total.m3),  #calculate the cumulative sum of calanus from surface to depth
    cum_dens.I = cumsum(calanus.I.m3),
    cum_dens.II = cumsum(calanus.II.m3),
    cum_dens.III = cumsum(calanus.III.m3),
    cum_dens.IV = cumsum(calanus.IV.m3),
    cum_dens.V = cumsum(calanus.V.m3),
    cum_dens.Adult = cumsum(calanus.Adult.m3),
    total_dens.total = sum(calanus.total.m3), #calculate total calanus in the whole profile
    total_dens.I = sum(calanus.I.m3),
    total_dens.II = sum(calanus.II.m3),
    total_dens.III = sum(calanus.III.m3),
    total_dens.IV = sum(calanus.IV.m3),
    total_dens.V = sum(calanus.V.m3),
    total_dens.Adult = sum(calanus.Adult.m3),
    prop_cum_total     = if_else(total_dens.total > 0, 
                         cum_dens.total / total_dens.total, #proportion of calanus accumulated to this depth
                         NA_real_),
    
    prop_cum_I     = if_else(total_dens.I > 0, 
                         cum_dens.I / total_dens.I, #proportion of calanus accumulated to this depth
                         NA_real_),
    
    prop_cum_II     = if_else(total_dens.II > 0, 
                         cum_dens.II / total_dens.II, #proportion of calanus accumulated to this depth
                         NA_real_),
    
    prop_cum_III     = if_else(total_dens.III > 0, 
                         cum_dens.III / total_dens.III, #proportion of calanus accumulated to this depth
                         NA_real_),
    
    prop_cum_IV     = if_else(total_dens.IV > 0, 
                         cum_dens.IV / total_dens.IV, #proportion of calanus accumulated to this depth
                         NA_real_),
    
    prop_cum_V     = if_else(total_dens.V > 0, 
                         cum_dens.V / total_dens.V, #proportion of calanus accumulated to this depth
                         NA_real_),
    
    prop_cum_Adult     = if_else(total_dens.Adult > 0, 
                         cum_dens.Adult / total_dens.Adult, #proportion of calanus accumulated to this depth
                         NA_real_),
    
    max_depth = max(sample.depth..m.),
    perc_depth      = sample.depth..m. / max_depth #fractional depth (how far through the water column we are)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
 mutate(
  prop_cum_total  = case_when(prop_cum_total  <= 0 ~ 0.001, prop_cum_total  >= 1 ~ 0.999, TRUE ~ prop_cum_total),
  prop_cum_I      = case_when(prop_cum_I      <= 0 ~ 0.001, prop_cum_I      >= 1 ~ 0.999, TRUE ~ prop_cum_I),
  prop_cum_II     = case_when(prop_cum_II     <= 0 ~ 0.001, prop_cum_II     >= 1 ~ 0.999, TRUE ~ prop_cum_II),
  prop_cum_III    = case_when(prop_cum_III    <= 0 ~ 0.001, prop_cum_III    >= 1 ~ 0.999, TRUE ~ prop_cum_III),
  prop_cum_IV     = case_when(prop_cum_IV     <= 0 ~ 0.001, prop_cum_IV     >= 1 ~ 0.999, TRUE ~ prop_cum_IV),
  prop_cum_V      = case_when(prop_cum_V      <= 0 ~ 0.001, prop_cum_V      >= 1 ~ 0.999, TRUE ~ prop_cum_V),
  prop_cum_Adult  = case_when(prop_cum_Adult  <= 0 ~ 0.001, prop_cum_Adult  >= 1 ~ 0.999, TRUE ~ prop_cum_Adult)
)|>
  filter(!is.na(prop_cum_total),
         !is.na(prop_cum_I),
         !is.na(prop_cum_II),
         !is.na(prop_cum_III),
         !is.na(prop_cum_IV),
         !is.na(prop_cum_V),
         !is.na(prop_cum_Adult)) #filtering NA's from prop_cum

###############################################################################################

Ctd_Verticals_LJ <- Ctd_Verticals_LJ |> #piping Ctd_Verticals_LJ
  group_by(ID, Date) |> #grouping by ID and Date
  mutate(
    lat  = if (any(sample.depth..m. == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      latitude[which(sample.depth..m. == 0)[1]]
    } else {
      latitude[which.min(sample.depth..m.)]
    },  #mutating the latitude assigned at 0m depth (or shallowest depth) to be the latitude for that whole station
    long = if (any(sample.depth..m. == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      longitude[which(sample.depth..m. == 0)[1]]
    } else {
      longitude[which.min(sample.depth..m.)]
    }  #mutating the longitude assigned at 0m depth (or shallowest depth) to be the longitude for that whole station
  ) |>
  ungroup() #ungrouping after grouping

###############################################################################################

Integrated_new <- Ctd_Verticals_LJ |>
  #Removing rows where depth, temperature and calanus is NA for integration
  filter(!is.na(sample.depth..m.),
         !is.na(Temp),
        !is.na(calanus.total.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.I.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.II.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.III.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.IV.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.V.m3),
         !is.na(calanus.Adult.m3))|> 
  arrange(ID, Date, sample.depth..m.) |> #Sorting depth from surface to bottom within each station visit
  group_by(ID, Date, Year, Month, sample.depth..m., lat, long) |> #Averaging duplicate depths
  summarise(
    calanus.total.m3 = mean(calanus.total.m3, na.rm = TRUE), #averaging calanus at duplicate depths 
    calanus.I.m3 = mean(calanus.I.m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    calanus.II.m3 = mean(calanus.II.m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    calanus.III.m3 = mean(calanus.III.m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    calanus.IV.m3 = mean(calanus.IV.m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    calanus.V.m3 = mean(calanus.V.m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    calanus.Adult.m3 = mean(calanus.Adult.m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    total.zpl.m3     = mean(total.zpl.m3,     na.rm = TRUE), #averaging total copepods at duplicate depths
    Temp            = mean(Temp,             na.rm = TRUE), #averaging temperature at duplicate depths
    Salinity       = mean(Salinity,        na.rm = TRUE), #averaging salinity at duplicate depths
    Light              = mean(Light,               na.rm = TRUE), #averaging Light at duplicate depths
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(ID, Date, Year, Month, lat, long,) |> #trapezoid integration over depth profile within each station
  summarise(
    calanus_wc_total      = trapz(calanus.total.m3), #Calanus trapezoid integration (unit multiplication: ind m-3 × m = ind m-2)
    calanus_wc_I      = trapz(calanus.I.m3),
    calanus_wc_II      = trapz(calanus.II.m3),
    calanus_wc_III      = trapz(calanus.III.m3),
    calanus_wc_IV      = trapz(calanus.IV.m3),
    calanus_wc_V      = trapz(calanus.V.m3),
    calanus_wc_Adult      = trapz(calanus.Adult.m3),
    total_zoo_wc    = trapz(total.zpl.m3), #Total zooplankton trapezoid integration (unit multiplication: ind m-3 × m = ind m-2)
    temp_mean       = mean(Temp,      na.rm = TRUE), #Calculating mean temperature through the water column
    salinity_mean   = mean(Salinity, na.rm = TRUE), #Calculating mean salinity through the water column
    Light_mean        = mean(Light,        na.rm = TRUE), #Calculating mean Light through the water column
    max_depth       = max(sample.depth..m.), #assigning max_depth
    n_depths        = n(), #calculating the number of depth stratified samples collected at each station
    .groups = "drop" #dropping the grouping
  ) |>
  #cleaning up
  mutate(
    Month   = as.numeric(Month), #making month numeric
    Year    = as.numeric(Year), #making year numeric
    year_c    = Year - mean(Year),   #centering year for model stability
    Light_mean  = if_else(Light_mean  < 0, 0, Light_mean), #removing unrealistic values of Light (light cannot be negative) 
    temp_mean = if_else(temp_mean < 0, 0, temp_mean), #removing negative water temperatures and keeping the lowest temp at 0
    log_calanus_total = log(calanus_wc_total + 0.001), #logging integrated calanus and adding a small constant to avoid logging 0  
    log_calanus_I = log(calanus_wc_I + 0.001),
    log_calanus_II = log(calanus_wc_II + 0.001),
    log_calanus_III = log(calanus_wc_III + 0.001),
    log_calanus_IV = log(calanus_wc_IV + 0.001),
    log_calanus_V = log(calanus_wc_V + 0.001),
    log_calanus_Adult = log(calanus_wc_Adult + 0.001)
  )
```
